a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan to build the reserve to 8 almost certainly leaves us both with empty units. I intend to take 4 in round 1 and won't pretend otherwise. If you'd rather propose something else, tell me. After that I'll operate with you every round to help refill the reserve for you.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: I took 4 as I said I would. From now on I'll operate every round so the reserve refills for you, and I won't take anything more.
